note: KIT RANGES (3 Nov), from the kit's sample code, untested on this arm: for the first powered session only (needs.md C7). scripts/first_moves.py explores inside them (at most 45 degrees from home by default) and proposes measured ranges in calib/arm_limits_proposed.json. Must match firmware/mimic_arm/arm_logic.h (a unit test checks). Real moves need placeholder false AND limits_checked_by_hand true. Pins (2 Nov) are from the kit's sample code, untested on this arm. GRIP (4 Nov, Girik): a LOWER angle closes this claw; open (and where the 5 s relaxation returns it) is 90. grip_closed_limit_deg is the one setting for the direction (below open = lower closes). It is PROVISIONAL at 3: with foam pads the empty jaws are still wider than a 19 mm die at 20, so the limit goes almost to the end, but not to 0, because 0 is the servo's own end stop and may stall even with the jaws empty. Girik is measuring the pad-to-pad gap at 90 and 20 to predict whether 3 is enough; change it in both files. The grip is only ever sent from the closed limit to 140; grip_range_deg 0-140 is the servo's whole range. grip_hold_deg (what 'grip close' uses) is unknown until scripts/grip_test.py, and may not equal the closed limit.
